verses.en: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado aquele cuja transgressão é perdoada, e cujo pecado é coberto.
verses.en_web: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.en_bbe: <Of David. Maschil.> Happy is he who has forgiveness for his wrongdoing, and whose sin is covered.

verses.en: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado o homem a quem o Senhor não atribui a iniqüidade, e em cujo espírito não há dolo.
verses.en_web: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man in whom the Lord sees no evil, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.

verses.en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.pt: Enquanto guardei silêncio, consumiram-se os meus ossos pelo meu bramido durante o dia todo.
verses.en_web: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
verses.en_bbe: When I kept my mouth shut, my bones were wasted, because of my crying all through the day.

verses.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.pt: Porque de dia e de noite a tua mão pesava sobre mim; o meu humor se tornou em sequidão de estio.
verses.en_web: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: For the weight of your hand was on me day and night; my body became dry like the earth in summer. (Selah.)

verses.en: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.pt: Confessei-te o meu pecado, e a minha iniqüidade não encobri. Disse eu: Confessarei ao Senhor as minhas transgressões; e tu perdoaste a culpa do meu pecado.
verses.en_web: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: I made my wrongdoing clear to you, and did not keep back my sin. I said, I will put it all before the Lord; and you took away my wrongdoing and my sin. (Selah.)

verses.en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.pt: Pelo que todo aquele é piedoso ore a ti, a tempo de te poder achar; no trasbordar de muitas águas, estas e ele não chegarão.
verses.en_web: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause let every saint make his prayer to you at a time when you are near: then the overflowing of the great waters will not overtake him.

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.pt: Tu és o meu esconderijo; preservas-me da angústia; de alegres cânticos de livramento me cercas.
verses.en_web: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: You are my safe and secret place; you will keep me from trouble; you will put songs of salvation on the lips of those who are round me. (Selah.)

verses.en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.pt: Instruir-te-ei, e ensinar-te-ei o caminho que deves seguir; aconselhar-te-ei, tendo-te sob a minha vista.
verses.en_web: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you knowledge, teaching you the way to go; my eye will be your guide.

verses.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.pt: Não sejais como o cavalo, nem como a mula, que não têm entendimento, cuja boca precisa de cabresto e freio; de outra forma não se sujeitarão.
verses.en_web: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be like the horse or the ass, without sense; ...

verses.en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.pt: O ímpio tem muitas dores, mas aquele que confia no Senhor, a misericórdia o cerca.
verses.en_web: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: The sinner will be full of trouble; but mercy will be round the man who has faith in the Lord.

verses.en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.pt: Alegrai-vos no Senhor, e regozijai-vos, vós justos; e cantai de júbilo, todos vós que sois retos de coração.
verses.en_web: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
verses.en_bbe: Be glad in the Lord with joy, you upright men; give cries of joy, all you whose hearts are true.
